items.b: MOVADO'S HALF-YEAR OPERATING INCOME RISES 409% TO $21.9 MILLION
items.t: The six months to 31 July put net sales at $312.2 million, up 6.3%, and gross profit at $182.4 million, up 14.8%. Gross margin reached 58.4% against 54.1%. Diluted earnings were $0.84 a share against $0.20. Source: Form 10-Q, filed 26 August.

items.b: WATCHES OF SWITZERLAND HOLDS 5-10% GUIDANCE 17 WEEKS INTO THE YEAR
items.t: The AGM trading update of 3 September reiterates 5% to 10% revenue growth at constant currency and 40 to 80 basis points of adjusted EBIT margin expansion. Capital expenditure is guided at £60 million to £70 million, cash conversion near 70%. No regional revenue figure is given.

items.b: CHRISTIE'S WATCH SALES ROSE 39% IN THE FIRST HALF, ON THE HOUSE'S OWN FIGURES
items.t: Geneva's May rare watches sale made $42.2 million, which Christie's calls its highest various-owner watch result. Hong Kong made $35.7 million the same month, up 40%. The figures reach the trade inside the release naming Remi Guillemin global head of watches.

items.b: IBJA GOLD ADDS ₹2,549 AFTER ₹4,651 CAME OFF ACROSS TWO DAYS
items.t: 10 grams of 24-carat gold stood at ₹1.54 lakh on 3 September and silver at ₹2.33 lakh a kilogram, up ₹4,420 after an ₹8,803 two-day fall. A named analyst credits a prime ministerial appeal against unnecessary gold buying; no mechanism is shown and the rate rose the next day.

items.b: FOUR METALS LOWER AT 06:02 ET, ALL FOUR STILL ABOVE 3 SEPTEMBER
items.t: Gold $4,465.40, silver $66.57, platinum $1,802.00, palladium $1,384.00, re-read at press time and written back to the tape. Against 3 September's marks gold is up $38.60 or 0.8720% and palladium $36.00 or 2.6706%. Gold-silver ratio 67.08 against 67.50.

items.b: A ROYAL BROOCH SUPERLATIVE IS NARROWED, AND THE PRICE STANDS
items.t: The 26 August Elmwood's piece said no 1.10-carat parcel of small goods approaches $29,455 a carat anywhere in the trade, disclosing no check. It now cites Guru Diam's August 2026 wholesale melee table, $370 to $900 a carat, which puts the brooch at 32.7 times that ceiling. The $29,455 was correct as published.
